name: tabs
title: Tabs
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Open, rename and close tabs without ending their programs; choose the tab bar's look.
description: Adds shell tabs and lets you show an existing resource or view in a tab. Closing a tab only changes the layout: its programs keep running. Turn this off to remove these tab commands, menus and shortcuts; existing layouts and terminals remain.

works_with.without: New tab cannot start a shell; closing the last tab leaves the layout unchanged
An agent is shown as its bridge terminal

keys: Prefix .: move tab to a number
menu_items: New tab (+, the only tab-bar button)
settings: doc/settings/tabs: tab number style, chips and program titles
